title: research: P104 B-form nine-term decoder floor >= 56 (no κ claim)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

## Change and mathematical scope

Proof (with recorded finite searches) that every nine-term decoder of a rank-9 **B-form** realisation `M = D₁ G D₂ + c βᵀ` of the P104 pattern costs at least **56**, including singular `D`. No κ claim, no supplier word; this is a lower-bound / obstruction result for the masked carrier floor of #2338 on P104.

- Case I (`|supp c|, |supp β| ≤ 12`): proved by counting.
- Case II/III (`|supp β| ≤ 4` or `|supp c| ≤ 4`, any `D`): proved reduction to a census statement; census run recorded on Kaggle, 0 configurations alive (regular `D`: V0–V3, 701 each; singular `D`: 740 pairs, 446 configurations).
- Coverage: `|supp c| ≥ 13` forces `|supp β| ≤ 4` (exact biclique check).
- Lean: `BForm.bform_floor` builds with no `sorry` (axioms `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`). The finite facts and the census enter as named hypotheses (`Capacity`, `RootFact`, `SpanFact`, `BicliqueFact`, `CensusFact`).

Remaining obligations: non-B-form, non-A2 rank-9 realisations of P104 (open), decoders with ≥ 10 terms, P112/E8.

## Task and overlap

Base `3f0152a32`. Task `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, scope **refined** to the B-form case on P104. Only `research/p104-bform-nine-term-floor/` is added.
Overlap: research/e8-rank9-realisations §5 lists the B-form decoder floor as open; a2-family-decoder-floors / a2-family-b-locus cover the A2 family; the census extends research/nine-term-outside-colspace (`cnt9b`) with the 104 port classes as extra column classes, repeated survivors and, for singular `D`, an exact root-rank bound `lbz`.

## Validation

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-bform-nine-term-floor --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-bform-nine-term-floor
```

The bounded verifier re-runs S0–S3 and the `lbz` self-test, authenticates the census logs by sha256, scans the Lean sources for `sorry`/`admit`/`axiom`, and runs failure controls (tampered log, corrupted hash). The full census replay (~1.5 h on 4 cores) is in `kaggle/`; logs in `evidence/kaggle/`. Lean: `cd lean && lake exe cache get && lake build`. An earlier S2 run failed on exactly the 104 port pairs; the lemma was corrected (S2') and the check now asserts that structure.

## Credit

Prepared by Matarener with Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code; census runs on Kaggle; Lean formalisation by Claude. Census code from research/nine-term-outside-colspace (DreamingOfClouds), extended. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Is every rank-9 realisation of the P104 pattern B-form or A2? With this package and the A2 floors it would close nine-term case (c) of #2338 on P104.
2. Formalise the E8 hyperplane classification so `RootFact` and `SpanFact` become Lean theorems (in progress).
